description: Circular buffer overflow due to incorrect head/tail logic
user_question: Why does the buffer_push fail after 63 elements?
expected_root_cause: Circular buffer full condition (next_head == tail) means one slot always reserved - max 63 elements in 64-byte buffer
expected_fix: Accept that one slot is reserved for full/empty distinction, or use separate count variable to use all 64 slots

expected_code_issues.suggestion: This is standard circular buffer behavior - max capacity is size-1. Use count variable if full capacity needed.
